newsitem.title: USA: U.S. steel service center shipments remain strong.
newsitem.headline: U.S. steel service center shipments remain strong.

text.p: The average daily shipping rate for U.S. steel service centers reached 115,653 tons in May, making it the second highest shipping month in over 20 years, the Steel Service Center Institute said.
The best month was in March this year.
The daily shipping rate rose 1.8 percent in May over April.

Year-to-date through five months, the overall shipping rate for all products rose 7.6 percent compared with 1996. Leading the way were stainless products, up 12.9 percent, carbon tubing, up 10.8 percent, and carbon flat rolled and carbon bars, both 8.5 percent ahead of last year's totals.
Compared with the record shipping year of 1995, the total 1997 shipping rate is 1.5 percent higher through May, on track for a new record high.
